QUESTION ONE: Prose

Read the passage provided (Text A — a short story about a teenager helping their parent pack up a childhood home before a move).

Analyse how the writer uses language to convey the emotional weight of leaving a place behind.

Support your answer with evidence from the text.
questions.markingGuide: Achieved (3-4): Engage with the text by addressing the question, exploring a relevant idea using analysis-related terminology. Show awareness that meaning has been deliberately crafted. Include specific and relevant details from the text. Merit (5-6): Convincingly address the question, presenting a reasoned and clear discussion of one or more ideas. Show awareness of deliberate crafting for a particular purpose. Weave a range of specific details from the text. Excellence (7-8): Develop an insightful or original argument or interpretation. Make judgments about how effects and meanings relate to the purpose of the text. Look for: how ordinary objects (a doorframe with height marks, a faded curtain) are given emotional significance through descriptive language; contrast between the parent's stoicism and the teenager's reluctance; sensory details that anchor memory to place; shifts in tone from practicality to grief; how the empty house becomes a symbol of endings and beginnings.
